earlier_attempts.observed_error: Unhandled Client error event: Connection terminated unexpectedly
earlier_attempts.root_cause: The pool removes its idle client error listener at checkout. The operation awaited the query but did not own a checked-out Client error listener.
earlier_attempts.correction: Attach a lease-owned connection error listener; retire the client on that event and remove the listener after retirement or before safe release.
earlier_attempts.evidence_limit: Captured terminal output; the process exited before a complete scenario JSON report was emitted.

earlier_attempts.observed_error: All application sessions must be closed: actual 1, expected 0
earlier_attempts.root_cause: An immediate pg_stat_activity assertion followed pool.end before the server finished asynchronous disconnect cleanup.
earlier_attempts.correction: Bounded polling of the actual server session count, with a separately recorded resource-finalization scenario.
earlier_attempts.evidence_limit: The case runner finished without printed individual scenario failures; the process exited at the final assertion before its full JSON report was emitted.

limitations: Earlier failures are summarized from captured tool output, not complete saved transcripts.
Each runtime attempt used the common disposable runner; no production database was changed.

independent_review_findings.finding: Idle client retirement could wait indefinitely for a half-open peer even after removal from pool capacity.
independent_review_findings.reproduction: Reviewer used a real allowHalfOpen loopback peer with PostgreSQL startup and stubbed SQL. With cleanupMs20, request remained unsettled after200ms and remove listener remained; destroying peer completed original cancellation.
independent_review_findings.correction: Retain an owned net.Socket per driver client, start a retirement force-destroy timer, still await remove/end, and dispose timer/listener.
independent_review_findings.regression_scope: Real TCP and driver retirement; SQL answers are explicitly stubbed.

independent_recheck.result: closed reproduced P2; no remaining demonstrated material finding in reviewed scope
